observed.pricing_architecture: Descript combines per-editor subscriptions with plan allowances for media hours and AI credits; paid plans can add top-ups and Enterprise is custom.

plans.name: Hobbyist annual
plans.price_note: Annual-equivalent monthly price; includes 10 media hours and 400 AI credits in captured source.

plans.name: Creator annual
plans.price_note: Annual-equivalent monthly price; includes 30 media hours and 800 AI credits in captured source.

plans.name: Business annual
plans.price_note: Annual-equivalent monthly price; includes 40 media hours and 1,500 AI credits in captured source.

free_access.note: Official pricing page lists a Free plan.

expansion_vectors.description: Higher tiers package additional media and AI capacity.
Paid plans support additional capacity purchases.

analysis.monetization_summary: Descript wraps AI-intensive editing features in a creator-friendly seat subscription with capacity allowances.
